Setting the angle θ between the 60 and 68 sides, the area gives ½·60·68·sinθ = 960, so sinθ = 8/17 and cosθ = ±15/17. The third side x then satisfies x² = 3600 + 4624 ∓ 7200, so x² = 1024 or 15424. That gives x = 32 or x = 8√241 ≈ 124.2.

Both values satisfy the stated conditions, so the problem is technically ambiguous. The 32 case is the right triangle 32-60-68, whose area is ½·32·60 = 960, and it is almost certainly the intended answer. The program's claim that 32 is the only solution is wrong, but the submitted answer matches the intended one.
